title: Restructure RISE into five rooms over static content
acceptance: Rooms fold into Home, Read, Library, Make and Settings; every old route id and path keeps working.
The catalog is a static file; the Worker decision route, Neon and Redis are removed.
Exact-head required CI and Full validation pass before merge.

evidence.note: Merged 2026-10-04 as 76386dba after main (#371, #384-#397) was merged into it; conflicts and four merge-interaction defects resolved on the branch.
Full validation (all unit and browser shards) passed at 61e817aa, the merged head.

Production served this release marker; catalog.json passed the browser contract, retired routes answered 410 and Opus recitation served as audio/ogg (checked by hand after a rollout-race check failure; see FND-005).

summary: Five rooms over static, content-addressed data are in production. Retiring the old secrets and audio branch is FND-004; reader and device acceptance stay with RDR-007 and RDR-009.

activity.summary: Recorded from repository and CI evidence after integration.
